item.title: Americans in Sweden: Are the Swedish treating you differently as international tensions rise?
item.description: Relations between the US and Europe - including Sweden - are increasingly tense and Swedish troops are now in Greenland after Donald Trump's threats to annexe the Danish territory - but are world events affecting the everyday lives of Americans in Sweden?

item.title: Grammar guide: When to use compound words in Swedish
item.description: Särskrivning, or writing compound words in Swedish incorrectly as two separate words, is a common mistake among Swedish learners (and among Swedes in general, for that matter). But how do you avoid them?

item.title: Today in Sweden: A roundup of the latest news on Wednesday
item.description: Greenland crisis could cause Swedish 'stagflation', new wolf territory in Östergötland, Social Democrats propose new law after Rönninge murder and more news from Sweden on Wednesday.

item.title: Swedish minister: 'EU needs to step up on defence'
item.description: This week’s episode of Sweden in Focus Extra features an interview with Jessica Rosencrantz, Sweden's Minister for EU Affairs.

item.title: Olympics, pensions and sportlov: What changes in Sweden in February 2026
item.description: Will Sweden bring back gold at the Winter Olympics? Will the Melodifestivalen music contest throw up any half decent songs? Here are some of the main things happening in Sweden in February.

item.title: Swedish krona reaches four-year high against dollar
item.description: One US dollar cost 9.12 Swedish kronor on Wednesday morning. The krona has not been this strong against the dollar since the start of 2022.

item.title: Fika, meatballs and Kalles kaviar: Which Swedish foods habits have you adopted?
item.description: It's hard to live in Sweden for more than a few months without adopting some of the local food habits, with meatballs, fredagsmys, A-fil and even aberrations like tuna paste among the foods now regularly eaten by foreigners who answered The Local's survey.

item.title: Swedish word of the day: röra
item.description: Today's word of the day has a number of different meanings.

item.title: 19-year-old jailed for plot to attack Stockholm festival
item.description: A Stockholm court on Wednesday jailed a 19-year-old for nearly eight years for having plotted to attack a culture festival on behalf of the Islamic State.

item.title: MEPs block move to cut passenger compensation for flight delays in Europe
item.description: The European parliament on Wednesday rejected plans to allow airlines to incur longer flight delays before having to compensate passengers, locking horns with member states that have backed the move.
